description: Find Swappa device product slugs by free-text name (e.g. "iphone 15", "galaxy s24", "macbook air"). Returns matching products with their slug (needed by device_prices / recent_sales) and current starting price. Use this first when you don't already know the exact slug.

query.description: Device name or partial name, e.g. "iPhone 15 Pro" or "Pixel 8".

name: search_device
